chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 315: Xiao Chen Reaches Nirvana and Slays Hai Fanyun
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen awakens from months of cultivation, breaking into the Nirvana realm. On New Year's Eve, he faces a siege, kills Hai Fanyun with the Weng sound technique, and issues an open challenge from the Yellow Clay Altar.
og_title: Nirvana Awakening: Xiao Chen's First Death Tribulation
og_description: Xiao Chen emerges from the Yellow Clay Altar in the Nirvana realm, defeats a Sun Knight and a Fang Tianqi's brother, then hunts down and kills Hai Fanyun using the soul-shattering Weng sound.
twitter_title: The Sound That Kills: Xiao Chen's Nirvana Breakthrough
twitter_description: Xiao Chen annihilates over a hundred pursuers with a single 'Weng' after breaking into Nirvana and killing Hai Fanyun on New Year's Eve.
